description: Daily snapshots per project: MRR, visitors, signups, revenue, health. Date-windowed, not cursor-based, because snapshots are restated when late Stripe events land — re-pull a trailing window and upsert. (GET /api/v1/metrics; needs the read:metrics scope)

project.description: Project id or slug. Resolved inside the key owner's portfolio; an unowned value matches nothing rather than 404ing.

name: read_metrics
